entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: A ghoulcaller who rules Thraben with an army of the dead and writes bored letters to her brother; she defeats Wilhelt's army with bats.

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: Gisa's brother, a stitcher who builds constructs of flesh and refuses to rescue her from boredom.

entities.name: Wilhelt
entities.description: A woodsman who died and rose as a ghoul with his own army, who marches on Thraben to win Gisa's love.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer whose zombies took Thraben before she moved on, and whom Gisa calls Geralf's arrogant girlfriend.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: A city taken by Liliana's zombies and now ruled by Gisa, whose cathedral is her throne room.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: The main cathedral of Thraben, used by Gisa as her seat.

entities.name: Gisa's army of the dead
entities.description: The undead population of Thraben, including rats, bats, ravens and risen townsfolk, under Gisa's control.

entities.name: Wilhelt's army
entities.description: A legion of ghouls raised by Wilhelt that marches on Thraben and is defeated.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place.

events.summary: Gisa writes her brother that she is bored and has exhausted the living of Thraben, wishing for an opponent worthy of her.
events.quote: Things have been getting dreadfully dull here in Thraben.

events.summary: Geralf tells Gisa that she has only herself to blame and not to contact him again.
Gisa smashes porcelain in a tantrum in the cathedral, having secured Thraben by eliminating most of the living after Liliana's zombies took it.
events.quote: The plate shattered against the wall

events.summary: Wilhelt, a risen ghoul with his own army, marches toward Thraben to win Gisa's love.
events.quote: At the head of his column of the dead, Wilhelt marched on Thraben

events.summary: Gisa writes Geralf another angry letter complaining that he will not send her anything to do.
events.quote: I knew you were my inferior.

events.summary: Geralf refuses again to come to Gisa's aid.
events.quote: No, I will not come to save you from the fruits of your own machinations.

events.summary: Gisa spots an army of the dead led by a rider approaching Thraben and runs to meet it, delighted to have something to do.
events.quote: Someone was riding along the road to Thraben.

events.summary: Wilhelt reaches the gates and declares himself to Gisa, who does not remember him and tries to whistle him into thralldom.
events.quote: Finally, tilting her head to the side, she asked, "Do I know you?"

events.summary: Gisa's whistle tries to bind Wilhelt, but he resists and breaks her hold; Gisa retreats behind the gates.
events.quote: breaking the tie between them as Gisa's whistle died, choked off in her throat

events.summary: Wilhelt breaks through the gates and his army is attacked by swarms of undead birds, then by the dead who surge out of the shops.
events.quote: They were halfway down the avenue when the dead surged out of the buildings to either side

events.summary: Gisa urges Wilhelt to surrender; he refuses, so she leaves her soldiers to overwhelm his.
events.quote: Then she flounced away down the walk, not looking back

events.summary: Wilhelt sends a ghoul with a love letter to Gisa, but she seizes the ghoul's mind and reads it.
events.quote: A single ghoul ran into the square

events.summary: Gisa reads Wilhelt's letter, is offended that he implies she could get his name wrong, and resolves to destroy him.
Gisa screams and all the bats in Thraben descend on Wilhelt's army, forcing him to flee.
events.quote: Then Gisa screamed, and all the bats in Thraben descended.

events.summary: Wilhelt vanishes from the battlefield, and Gisa decides to go to her brother.
Gisa writes to Geralf that she is on her way to him, and Geralf begs her to go anywhere else.
events.quote: I am on my way to you now and should be there inside of the sennight.

relations.note: She is the unchallenged queen of Thraben.
relations.quote: Empress of the empty grave and unchallenged queen of Thraben

relations.note: He commands his own army of ghouls.
relations.quote: He had called his own army forth

relations.note: Wilhelt wants to be her king; she does not return his feelings.
She fights him and drives him off.

relations.quote: that arrogant girlfriend of yours, Liliana

relations.note: She rules the city from the cathedral.
